about_the_game:
Dive into the world of Breaking Point: Operation Exodus, an intense first-person shooter where the survival of humanity is at stake. This demo gives you a taste of the full experience, allowing you to face relentless alien enemies in a desperate battle for Earth.

📌 Demo Features:
✅ An exclusive level to test your skills and strategy.
✅ Frantic combat with an arsenal of advanced weapons.
✅ Challenging artificial intelligence that will test every move.
✅ High-quality graphics powered by Unreal Engine.

Do you have what it takes to withstand the invasion? Download the demo and prepare for the ultimate war.
